items.title: Results
items.quote: I’ve tried a lot of workouts, but doing Pilates with Lynn has completely changed the way I feel in my body. My core feels stronger, my posture is better… I leave every class feeling taller, stronger, and more energized
items.name: Christine M.

items.title: Core strength after having kids
items.quote: Nothing can compare to Classical Pilates. I love the small classes and individual attention… I've seen the difference in my core strength that I haven't had since before I had children.
items.name: Janice F.

items.title: Small classes, authentic method
items.quote: What sets her apart is her dedication to the authentic, original method directly passed down from Joseph Pilates… You truly get the benefits of private coaching even in a small group setting.
items.name: Anna L.

items.title: Recovery
items.quote: I was deconditioned after an illness and began working with her 8 months ago. She is very knowledgeable and patient and has helped me regain a lot of my strength and flexibility. I travel a longer distance to her but it is well worth it.
items.name: Alisa P.

items.title: The studio
items.quote: She creates such a welcoming and comfortable environment and tailors each session to her clients' individual goals and needs… Her private studio has more equipment than any other studio I've been to, and it's always spotless.
items.name: Juliana M.

items.title: Expertise
items.quote: She is an expert at spotting imbalances in the body and provides guidance on how to correct them. I am a figure skater… My balance, core activation, and posture has noticeably improved since working with her.
items.name: Lindsey K.
